gloss: feeling of helplessness; sense of powerlessness

definitions.gloss: feeling of helplessness; sense of powerlessness
definitions.explanation: The emotional state of feeling unable to do anything or make a difference. Often experienced in the face of overwhelming circumstances.

examples.japanese: {無力感|むりょくかん}に{襲|おそ}われた。
examples.english: I was overcome by a feeling of helplessness.

examples.japanese: {何|なに}もできない{無力感|むりょくかん}がつらい。
examples.english: The helplessness of not being able to do anything is painful.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きな{災害|さいがい}の{前|まえ}では{無力感|むりょくかん}を{感|かん}じずにはいられない。
examples.english: In the face of a major disaster, you can't help but feel powerless.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used with verbs expressing being overwhelmed or experiencing emotions: {無力感|むりょくかん}に{襲|おそ}われる, {無力感|むりょくかん}を{感|かん}じる, {無力感|むりょくかん}に{苛|さいな}まれる.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無力感|むりょくかん}に{襲|おそ}われる (to be overwhelmed by helplessness)
- {無力感|むりょくかん}を{感|かん}じる (to feel helpless)
- {無力感|むりょくかん}に{苛|さいな}まれる (to be tormented by helplessness)
- {深|ふか}い{無力感|むりょくかん} (deep sense of powerlessness)

WORD FORMATION:
{無|む} (without) + {力|りょく} (power) + {感|かん} (feeling). The 〜{感|かん} suffix creates emotion nouns from abstract concepts.
